methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Seed → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.5x) to $10M total raised proxy.

data.narrative:
Standard Subsea is a seed-stage ocean and maritime technology company founded by Christopher Amidon. The company has raised $10M+ to date. The comparable universe consists of three private-sector peers in ocean and maritime technology (Clippership, NetworkOcean, and Albacore); no public comparables exist in this subsector, limiting the applicability of public market multiples.

The valuation analysis applied stage-progression methodology, which represents the only applicable triangulation method given data constraints. This approach uses the $10M total raised as a proxy for current value and applies a 2.5x multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage advancement in frontier technology. This calculation yields an implied valuation of $25M.

The triangulated valuation range is $21M (low) to $29M (high), with a median of $25M. The narrow band reflects reliance on a single methodology rather than convergence across multiple approaches. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the 2.5x stage multiplier for ocean technology specifically, the absence of public market reference points, and limited visibility into the three private comparables' financial profiles and recent valuations. A fuller analysis would benefit from additional methodology inputs such as revenue multiples or discounted cash flow analysis, neither of which are currently available.
